title: Stroke style controls in Properties Panel: cap/join/miter and line-style picker
description: The engine model already defines StrokeCap ('none'|'round'|'square'), StrokeJoin ('miter'|'round'|'bevel'), miterLimit (default 3), and a StrokeStyle union (solid/dashed/dotted/ragged/stippled/hatched) on SolidStroke in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts. The SWF encoder in packages/swf/src/shapes.ts writes these into the LINESTYLE2 record inside DefineShape4. But PropertiesPanel.tsx (the shape-selected view) hardcodes caps:'round', joints:'round', miterLimit:3 everywhere it constructs a stroke and never surfaces any UI for them. Scope: add to the Shape section of PropertiesPanel: (1) a Cap dropdown (None / Round / Square) with icons or short labels; (2) a Join dropdown (Miter / Round / Bevel); (3) a numeric miter-limit field that appears when join='miter'; (4) a line-style picker showing Solid / Dashed / Dotted as the most common options (hatched/ragged/stippled can be deferred). All changes must propagate through the updateAllPaths pattern already in place, so the renderer and SWF export see the correct LINESTYLE2 values. Acceptance: select a shape, change cap to 'square', publish SWF, verify Ruffle renders square end-caps; same for miter join with a visible corner angle.
